description: Send a test message through the full agent pipeline and read its reply, without needing a real consumer number. Pass conversation_id from a previous reply to continue the same test conversation. Known limitation: while ai_audience is ALLOWLISTED_ONLY this returns agent_response: "" with no_response_reason: "ELIGIBILITY_CHECK_FAILED", no matter which consumer number is involved - check mba_get_agent_settings before concluding the agent is broken.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

conversation_id.description: Optional - continue an existing test conversation.

user_msg.description: The message to send to the agent.

name: mba_test_agent

outputSchema.description: The AI agent response and test conversation metadata

conversation_id.description: The test conversation identifier. Use this in subsequent requests for multi-turn conversations.

handoff_reason.description: If the agent hands off to a human, this contains the reason

message_id.description: Unique identifier for this message exchange

no_response_reason.description: If the agent did not generate a response, this contains the reason (e.g. ELIGIBILITY_CHECK_FAILED)

product_variant_ids.description: The variant IDs of the products referenced in the agent response

quick_replies.description: Suggested quick reply messages generated by the AI agent

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the response was generated

title: Test the agent
